title: Landing zone project
description: One file per project and environment, stored at projects/<business_unit>/<project>/<environment>.yaml. Closed lists (regions, roles, delegations...) come from engine/catalog/catalog.yaml.

engine_version.title: Engine version
engine_version.description: Exact engine version (SemVer) used to deploy this file. The pipeline runs the engine from tag engine/v<engine_version>.

business_unit.title: Business unit
business_unit.description: Short code of the business unit. Must match the first folder of the file path. Lowercase letters and digits, 2-6 characters, starting with a letter.

project.title: Project
project.description: Short project name. Must match the second folder of the file path. Lowercase letters and digits, 2-14 characters, starting with a letter.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Environment. Must match the file name (<environment>.yaml).

subscription_id.title: Subscription ID
subscription_id.description: Azure subscription (GUID) dedicated to this project and environment. Requested from the platform team.

location.title: Region
location.description: Azure region for every resource of the project.

tags.title: Business tags
tags.description: Mandatory business tags, applied to every resource. Extra tags are allowed (lowercase keys). The engine adds business_unit, project, environment, managed_by, engine_version and source; those keys cannot be set here.

cost_center.title: Cost center
cost_center.description: Cost center charged for the project.

business_owner.title: Business owner
business_owner.description: Email of the person accountable for the project.

technical_owner.title: Technical owner
technical_owner.description: Email of the technical contact (person or team mailbox).

access.title: Access
access.description: Entra ID groups created by the engine. Each entry creates the group sg-az-<business_unit>-<project>-<environment>-<name> and assigns its roles on the project resource group.

network.title: Network
network.description: Optional. Without this block the engine creates no network.

address_space.title: Address space
address_space.description: CIDR ranges of the VNet, assigned by the platform team. They must not overlap with any other project or the hub.

peer_to_hub.title: Peer to hub
peer_to_hub.description: Connect the VNet to the hub of the same environment and region (declared in projects/_platform/platform.yaml).

dns_servers.title: DNS servers
dns_servers.description: Custom DNS servers. Leave empty to use the hub DNS servers when peered, or Azure DNS otherwise.

subnets.title: Subnets
subnets.description: Subnets of the VNet. Each one gets its own NSG.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Send the subscription Activity Log and resource diagnostics to the central Log Analytics workspace.

log_analytics.title: Central Log Analytics
log_analytics.description: Enable diagnostic settings towards the central workspace. Disable only in sandbox subscriptions.

overrides.title: Name overrides
overrides.description: Exceptional: replace a generated name, e.g. to adopt a pre-existing resource. Requires a justification reviewed by the platform team.

justification.title: Justification
justification.description: Why the generated name cannot be used.

address.title: Address
address.description: An alias from the catalog or a CIDR.

name.title: Group suffix
name.description: Suffix of the Entra ID group name. Unique within the file.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Built-in roles granted on the project resource group.

members.title: Members
members.description: User principal names (UPN) added to the group. Optional: membership can also be managed outside the engine.

name.title: Name
name.description: Subnet name without prefix (the engine adds snet-). Unique within the file.

delegation.title: Delegation
delegation.description: Delegate the subnet to an Azure service (catalog alias).

nsg_rules.title: NSG rules
nsg_rules.description: Rules of the subnet NSG. Priorities are assigned automatically in list order (100, 110, ...) unless set explicitly.

ports.title: Destination ports
ports.description: Ports or ranges, as text. Use "*" for all.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Only to force a value. Lower number = evaluated first.
